generation_review.prompt: Draw exactly ONE original Small Seal glyph from the attached four historical specimens of the SAME codepoint. Study all AVAILABLE THX, CCZ, QJZ and DYC specimens, preserve all defining stroke branches, open gaps, closed counters, detachments and bar-length relationships. Choose one coherent attested whole construction; never blend incompatible variants and never substitute a modern Chinese character. Use THX's clearer spacing when that same construction is attested in the other sources, while considering every available source. Redraw as harmonious Gothic sans-serif monoline font centerline trajectories with absolutely CONSTANT stroke width, smooth rounded Bézier-like curves, precise straight bars, round caps and round joins. No pressure modulation, swelling, taper, brush perimeter, texture, serifs or blobs. Every stroke has identical width, approximately 3% of full square canvas; keep dense counters and gaps open. Exactly one complete glyph centered inside central70% of a square 1:1 canvas, generous empty margins. Pure BLACK strokes on fully TRANSPARENT background. No text, labels, codepoint, frame, chart, grid, watermark, color, shadows or additional specimens. Preserve structural details rather than decorative resemblance. Codepoint U3D153. Structural reading aid: Two detached forks top. Beneath them a broad horizontal crossbar with TWO short downward stems each curving outward at their bases, forming shallow outward feet. A second longer detached horizontal bar below feet. From middle of second lower bar a short descending stub bends right then curls down and sweeps to lower-left terminal. Preserve second bar detached from feet.
